video.title: She Makes $10M/Year and Doesn’t Even Exist (AI Influencers Explained)

summary: Chris Koerner interviews Romain (Roma) Torres, founder of Arcads, an AI tool for generating talking AI actors for video ads and AI influencers. He shows examples (an AI influencer reportedly making $10M/year, a language app that reached $12-20M ARR on AI ads, disability-benefit lead gen) and explains which audiences tolerate AI ads. His fastest path to $10-15k/month is an AI UGC agency: find advertisers in the Facebook Ads Library, send the CEO a free AI recreation of one of their ads, and sell $2k/20-ad packages or $3-5k monthly retainers, later automating production via API. Key takeaway: AI video makes creative volume cheap; money is in selling it to companies already spending on ads, or building niche AI personas with consistent creative.

speakers.description: Founder of Arcads (arcads.ai), AI video ad generation

ideas.name: AI UGC video ad agency for companies already running Meta ads
ideas.one_liner: Find companies running many ads in the Facebook Ads Library, send a free AI-generated UGC ad copying one of theirs, and sell monthly ad packages.
ideas.customer: Small-to-mid companies (apps, e-commerce, lead-gen services) already spending heavily on Meta ads, reachable CEOs
ideas.problem: UGC creator ads cost ~$500 each and take weeks; brands need many creatives to test
ideas.offer: 20 AI UGC ads a month made with Arcads, cheaper and faster than human UGC creators

pricing.notes: Pitched as <1% of a $500k/month ad budget.

acquisition_channels.details: Find the CEO of each advertiser on LinkedIn and send a free sample ad recreating one of their existing UGC ads; 100 companies -> 20-30 calls -> about a third pay.

quote.text: I will just do that for a 100 companies. And then if I do that for 100 companies, I will probably get calls like phone calls with 20 30 of them
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

acquisition_channels.details: Prospect list from the public Facebook Ads Library; revenue estimates from Sensor Tower for apps (ad spend ~60-70% of revenue).

ideas.delivery: Operator scripts and generates videos in Arcads (AI actors, emotion tags, gestures, visual hooks); advanced: pipeline via Zapier/Make/n8n/Gumloop and the Arcads API to produce 100-500 ads a day.
unit_economics_claims: 100 outreach -> 20-30 calls -> ~1/3 close at $3-5k/month -> ~$15k/month in a month

acquisition.how: Prospecting from Ads Library and LinkedIn messaging can be agent-driven; UK PECR allows unsolicited B2B messages to limited-company decision makers but not sole traders, and LinkedIn limits automation.

onboarding.how: Brief and brand assets intake automated.

delivery.how: AI generates ads; human creative judgement on hooks.

uk_applicability.notes: Works in the UK; ASA/CAP code requires ads not to mislead, and AI-generated testimonials presented as real customers can breach CAP and the DMCC Act fake review rules.

risks: AI testimonial ads can be misleading (ASA/FTC)
Platform ad policy on synthetic media

tactics.name: Free-sample AI UGC outreach
steps: Browse the Facebook Ads Library for companies running many ads
Prefer smaller companies so you can reach the CEO
Estimate app ad budgets from Sensor Tower revenue x 0.6-0.7
Recreate one of their existing UGC ads with Arcads
Send it free to the CEO on LinkedIn
Repeat for 100 companies; sell 20-ad packages or $3-5k/month retainers

quote.text: I will tell them, okay, this UC ad that you probably paid $500 for and that took you three weeks to to get, I will do it for you
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

tactics.name: Automated ad factory
steps: Collect high-performing existing ads (longest-running first) in a Google Sheet
Have ChatGPT read the transcripts and write new scripts for your offer
Call the Arcads API through Zapier/Make/n8n/Gumloop
Generate 100-500 ads a day and test for winners

quote.text: connect to our API through an automation tool like Zapier, Make.com, NA10, Gumloop and create these ads automatically
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

tactics.name: Visual hooks in AI ads
steps: Add a gesture in the first second (pointing at camera)
Put the actor in an odd costume or setting (cosmonaut, Indiana Jones, skateboard)
A/B test hooks
Use emotion and accent tags so the voice is not robotic

quote.text: that's what we call a visual hook
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

tactics.name: Niche finding for AI influencers
steps: Use TikTok Creator Search Insights to find searches with few videos
Pick a trending niche
Find outlier videos (10x others) on accounts, log them in a Google Sheet and replicate
Post consistently and iterate with emotional scripts

quote.text: It will literally tell you which pieces of content are lacking from the platform
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

tactics.name: Match AI ads to less AI-sensitive audiences
steps: Prefer audiences less likely to notice AI (older, non-native English)
Or sell AI products where AI ads are 'dogfooding'
Avoid sophisticated categories where AI looks low effort

warnings.warning: Most AI influencer attempts fail from lack of consistency and creativity (survivorship bias).

quote.text: I can guarantee that there is 99% chance that they will not perform
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

warnings.warning: Consistency alone isn't enough without improving hooks and learning.

quote.text: there's a lot of accounts out there with thousands of videos and 82 followers
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: AI ads can turn off sophisticated audiences in competitive categories.
Target small companies; large ones hide the decision maker.

UK note (extractor): AI-generated testimonials and benefits-claim ads risk ASA/CMA action; claims-management lead gen is FCA-regulated; cold LinkedIn/DM outreach only to limited-company decision makers under PECR.

lessons.lesson: Pick audiences and categories where AI-generated creative is accepted or irrelevant.
Relevance beats realism: AI is fine if it solves the viewer's problem, like any ad spokesperson.

quote.text: I think that's the whole story of advertising

lessons.lesson: Sell to companies that already spend budget on the problem; your fee is a rounding error.

quote.text: for them spending 2K is like less than 1% of the ad budget they have
quote.speaker: Romain Torres

lessons.lesson: A free, personalised sample is a strong opener for creative services.
Volume testing finds viral ads; AI makes 100x creative output possible.

quote.text: I would like really increase the chances of finding this viral ad that will bring a lot of profit not by brainstorming

lessons.lesson: Unscalable services can be scaled with agents rather than hiring.

lessons.lesson: Replicate outlier content that already worked.
$10k/month via service is easy; $100k+ needs a product or owned audience.
